# AMEVA-Forge (v1.0.0)
> Browser-Native WebGPU Deep Learning Tensor & Autograd Engine with PyTorch Syntax

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/AMEVA-Forge
- Installation: `pip install ameva
# or CDN:
<script src="https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/lib/forge/ameva.js"></script>`
- Architecture: Compiles autograd graphs directly to WGSL WebGPU shaders, executing entirely on client GPU with zero server egress.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import ameva as am
x = am.tensor([1.0, 2.0], device='webgpu', requires_grad=True)
y = (x ** 2).sum()
y.backward()
```
